[RDSC.4a.3] **node_id.** Every `AlphaNode`, `BetaNode`, and `TerminalNode` atom
carries a `node_id` field — a compiler-assigned `uint32`
globally unique across all three atom types within a bundle.
`node_id = 0` is reserved as null/unset. Cross-references
between atoms (`BetaNode.right_alpha_id`, `BetaNode.left_parent_id`,
`TerminalNode.parent_beta_id`) use `node_id`. The loader builds one
map keyed by `node_id` spanning all three types.
